struct ParamUsed {
  uint B;
};
uint Helper(ParamUnused notRead, ParamUsed isRead) {
  return isRead.B;
}


RWStructuredBuffer<uint> OutBuffer;
[numthreads(1, 1, 1)]
void InitArgs() {
  OutBuffer[0] = Helper((ParamUnused)0, (ParamUsed)0);
}
